sources.title: Child Of Constraint — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full constraint section (official manual raw source)
supports: Animatable Influence can switch parents over time; Set Inverse fixes offset after enabling; not suitable for connected bone chains
limits: Blender authoring constraint only; not exported as an engine constraint; no engine test

sources.title: Parenting Objects — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: sections on Object Parent, Bone Parent, Parent Inverse, Keep Transform, non-uniform scale
supports: Object parent vs bone parent; Parent Inverse; Keep Transform; non-uniform scale can cause shear
limits: Blender behavior only; engine import behavior not covered

sources.title: Armature Deform Parent — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full section on Empty Groups, Automatic Weights, Envelope Weights
supports: Armature Deform Parent creates an Armature modifier and sets the armature as parent; automatic weights can be wrong on complex/overlapping parts
limits: Blender-specific; does not define a universal weight count or bone budget

sources.title: Armature Modifier — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full modifier options and Bind to sections
supports: Vertex groups of the same name drive weights; weights control per-bone influence; envelopes are an alternative; Preserve Volume behavior
limits: Blender-specific; no claim about engine import or LOD

sources.title: Object Origin — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full origin section including Set Origin types
supports: Object origin determines location/rotation/scale; Origin to 3D Cursor can place pivot at grip/hinge; Geometry to Origin is a different action
limits: Does not prescribe where a weapon grip or door hinge should be

sources.title: Copy Transforms Constraint — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full constraint section including Mix and Target/Owner spaces
supports: Copy Transforms matches target location/rotation/scale; Mix Before/After Original changes parent-like behavior; Target/Owner spaces must be explicit
limits: Authoring constraint; export requires baking; no engine test

sources.title: Limit Rotation Constraint — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full constraint section
supports: Limits Euler rotation per axis; does not work on bones affected by IK, where IK panel limits should be used
limits: Blender authoring only; not an engine joint; no test

sources.title: Bone Relations — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full Relations section including Local Location and Inherit Rotation/Scale
supports: Per-bone Local Location, Inherit Rotation and Inherit Scale change how child bones consume parent transforms; connected bones cannot be translated independently
limits: Blender behavior only; engine retarget/import may differ

sources.title: Skeletal Mesh Sockets in Unreal Engine
sources.author: Epic Games
sources.read_scope: full article
supports: Sockets are relative to a bone; mesh sockets for shared skeletons; Force Always Animated; dynamic Attach with Keep Relative/Keep World/Snap; Weld Simulated Bodies
limits: UE-specific; no project test; no Blender export/Unity/Godot coverage

sources.title: Unity-Technologies/FPSSample
sources.author: Unity Technologies
sources.version_date: Unity 2018.3.8f1; archived; repository last push 2025-10-23 (GitHub metadata)
sources.read_scope: README and repository metadata
supports: Full first-person multiplayer sample; archived learning resource; first/third person presentation split; separate character/weapon hierarchies
limits: Archived 2018.3 project; 18GB with LFS; not run; not a current-engine template

sources.title: FPSSample Documentation/Animation.md
sources.author: Unity Technologies
sources.read_scope: sections on Humanoid/Generic, animation jobs, first-person animation
supports: Third person Humanoid; first person Generic; separate character and weapon hierarchies; override controller; Offhand IK; first-person weapon drag/lead; first person is client-local
limits: Documentation only; no code execution; archived

sources.title: FPSSample Documentation/Characters.md
sources.author: Unity Technologies
sources.read_scope: sections on authoring, prefabs, Skeleton Component, procedural bones, Humanoid configuration
supports: Multiple prefabs per character (first person, client, server, hit collision, ragdoll); simplified skeletons; Skeleton Component stores hierarchy/names/default pose; procedural bones
limits: Documentation only; no code execution; archived

sources.title: Rendering of first person weapon model — Unity Discussions
sources.author: Unity Discussions participants incl. Mogens_H (FPS Sample team reply)
sources.read_scope: thread posts shown in search extract
supports: First-person material reprojects models to a fixed FOV; first-person models are made very small to avoid clipping; world-interaction arms need a different FOV
limits: Forum, not official manual; 2018 era; no run

sources.title: How to Make a Bow Attack Animation in Blender and Godot
sources.author: CoderNunk
sources.read_scope: full article text (images noted as not yet available by author)
supports: Bow needs a flex representation; this case uses base/limb/string bones; IK plus Limit Distance; automatic weights then fix; constraints are not exportable; idle/drawn/fire actions and BlendTree; BoneAttachment3D; weapon bone; fixed draw-length limitation
limits: Single-author tutorial; not a shipped game; no collision/network/LOD; fixed draw length; Godot 4 specifics; not run

sources.title: Unity FPSSample — Garry Newman
sources.author: Garry Newman
sources.read_scope: full blog post extract
supports: Arms and weapon are separate meshes/animators sharing a controller; first-person shader reprojects FOV; no self-shadowing; can still clip; author calls it a hack
limits: Third-party observation, 2018; may misread implementation; not official; not run

sources.title: Firearm Attachments — NeoFPS Scripting Reference
sources.author: NeoFPS documentation
sources.read_scope: full attachment section as returned by search extract
supports: Sockets parented to a gun bone; nested sockets; attachments transfer to same-named socket; aim offset relative to weapon transform; socket scale should be 1,1,1
limits: Commercial Unity asset docs; product-specific; no source/run

sources.title: Weapon System — FPS Animation Pack Unity
sources.author: Kinemation
sources.read_scope: weapon system overview and weapon mesh components
supports: Weapon model has its own Animator for bolt/mag parts; bone visibility and sound events are separate components
limits: Commercial asset docs; not open source; not run

sources.title: How can I keep the "Nock Point" on my bowstring from flattening?
sources.author: Eric Eaklor
sources.read_scope: question and comments
supports: Single string bone plus automatic weights/weight edits can leave a flat/curved nock point; no accepted fix in the thread
limits: Question with no accepted answer; not evidence of a fix

sources.title: bow string animating (with physics?) — Blender Artists
sources.author: Blender Artists thread participants
sources.read_scope: thread snippet
supports: Split string at middle, weight ends to limbs, middle to its own bone; use simple control bones; no stretch needed
limits: Old forum thread; no project/export test; not a standard

sources.title: Need help figuring how to keep a bowstring straight — Blender Artists
sources.author: Blender Artists thread participants
sources.read_scope: thread snippet
supports: User reports bowstring deformation differs at character scale vs >2m; cause not confirmed
limits: Anecdotal; no reproduction; cause unconfirmed
